description: Lists the dated steps of the federal student loan repayment overhaul: SAVE ended by court order (March 2026) with 90-day servicer notices from July 1, 2026 plus a final 30-day notice; RAP and the Tiered Standard plan from July 1, 2026; deferment and forbearance limits on loans from July 1, 2027; PAYE and ICR end and remaining borrowers move to RAP or IBR on July 1, 2028; the Parent PLUS consolidation deadline of June 30, 2028. Marks each as past or upcoming against a date and gives the current status of every plan.

on_date.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD for past/upcoming. Default 2026-11-02.

title: SAVE, PAYE, ICR and RAP transition dates
